cycle.assignment: all evidence through 2026-07-27 is development; the first 15 eligible settled HeadA target dates after cutoff are untouched frozen validation and may not be used for fitting, feature selection, threshold selection, or early reporting
cycle.reuse: only after the complete 15-date frozen report may that block enter the next cycle training set; at that moment the next 15 eligible settled HeadA target dates become the new untouched frozen block
no_peeking: do not publish interim frozen ROI or proper-score comparisons
operational coverage and data-quality monitoring is allowed without labels or model comparisons
a date enters the frozen count only when HeadA has at least one PIT candidate and all labels required by the report are settled

promotion.probability: paired target-date block 95% CI for Brier and logloss delta vs market is below zero
promotion.execution: fee-adjusted selected-trade ROI and uplift CI are above zero on fresh executable books
promotion.forward: same sign on the untouched 15-date frozen block
